title: Yijing departs by sea
shortSummary: Around 671, Yijing travelled south by sea, showing that pilgrimage and transmission were not limited to an overland route west of Chang'an.
curatorialDescription: The event opens a route comparison without merging different travellers' itineraries.
researchNote: Port of departure, stops and dates should be modelled from Yijing's writings and biographies.
